The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in panel margins and total annual margin calculations.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed because close(369.2, 6276.4) returned False, indicating a major mismatch in panel-level financial data. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with close(26185.96, 1090.76) returning False for 'total_annual_margin_14_day_usd'. Avoid current logic for calculating margins and totals, as the outputs are off by orders of magnitude compared to the expected values.
